title: Non-source activity does not displace dev source edits
why: Reads and framework-owned writes could fill the bounded mutation queue before being ignored, triggering false full reload recovery. Admission now discards resolved non-source activity, preserving symlink aliases, uncertain or large batches, environment edits, real changes, errors and explicit rescan notifications.
changelog: Filter filesystem access notifications before the bounded dev watcher queue
Ignored runtime traces, logs, generated files and component tests leave capacity for source edits
Native watcher rescan notifications trigger full cache recovery
